# Filtering data
```{r}
# Filtering the data to only include proteins identified with High confidence (FDR < 0.05) and have measurements (not NA)
ms_data_tmt_human_only_filt <- ms_data_tmt_human_only %>%
  filter(prot_conf == "High") %>%
  filter(if_all(matches("^DPSC[0-9]+_(DPSC|iN)"), ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
  rename_with(.cols = starts_with("DPSC"), ~ as.character(sample_name_map[.]))

# Log2 transformation of the data
ms_data_tmt_human_only_filt_log2 <- ms_data_tmt_human_only_filt %>%
  mutate(across(matches("^D[0-9]+_(DPSC|iN)"), ~ log2(. + 1)))
```

# PCA
```{r}
ms_pca <- ms_data_tmt_human_only_filt_log2 %>% 
  column_to_rownames("accession") %>% 
  select(matches("^D[0-9]+_(DPSC|iN)"))

ms_pca <- prcomp(t(ms_pca), scale. = TRUE)

percentVar <- round(100 * (ms_pca$sdev^2 / sum(ms_pca$sdev^2))[1:2])

ms_pca <- as.data.frame(ms_pca$x) %>% 
  mutate(sample_id = rownames(.)) %>% 
  inner_join(metadata, by = "sample_id")

ms_pca %>% 
ggplot(aes(PC1, PC2, color = donor, shape = cell_type, label = sample_id)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_text(vjust = -1, size = 3) +  # adds sample name labels
  xlab(paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% variance")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% variance")) +
  theme_light() +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

ggsave(paste(dir_list$plots, "PCA_MS_TMT_Human_Only.svg", sep = "/"), device = "svg", width = 10, height = 10)
ggsave(paste(dir_list$plots, "PCA_MS_TMT_Human_Only.png", sep = "/"), device = "png", dpi = 320, width = 10, height = 10, bg = "white")
```

## limma + BH FDR
```{r}
design <- model.matrix(~0 + metadata$donor_id + metadata$cell_type)
colnames(design) <- c(levels(metadata$donor_id), "iN_vs_DPSC")

ms_data_tmt_human_only_exp_mat <- ms_data_tmt_human_only_filt_log2 %>% 
  column_to_rownames("accession") %>% 
  select(metadata$sample_id) %>% 
  as.matrix()

fit <- limma::lmFit(ms_data_tmt_human_only_exp_mat, design)
fit_cont <- limma::eBayes(fit) 
ms_data_tmt_human_only_diff_analysis_results_limma <- limma::topTable(fit_cont, coef = "iN_vs_DPSC", adjust.method = "BH", confint = 0.95, number = Inf) %>% 
  mutate(status = case_when(adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC > 0.5 ~ "Upregulated", 
  adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC < -0.5 ~ "Downregulated",
  TRUE ~ "Insignificant"),
  status = factor(status, levels = c("Upregulated", "Downregulated", "Insignificant"))) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("accession") %>% 
  inner_join(ms_data_tmt_human_only_filt_log2 %>% select(accession, gene_name, gene_id, gene_id_entrez) %>% unique()) %>% 
  arrange(status, -logFC)

ms_data_tmt_human_only_diff_analysis_results_limma_filt <- ms_data_tmt_human_only_diff_analysis_results_limma %>% 
  filter(status != "Insignificant")

# ms_data_tmt_human_only_diff_analysis_results_limma %>% 
#   fwrite(paste(dir_list$docs, "DPSC_iN_diff_exp_proteins_tmt_hum_only_limma_fc0.5_padj0.05.csv", sep = "/"))

ms_data_tmt_human_only_diff_analysis_results_limma %>% 
  fwrite(paste(dir_list$docs, "DPSC_iN_diff_exp_proteins_tmt_hum_only_limma_fc1.0_padj0.05.csv", sep = "/"))
```

### Mean Plot
```{r}
plot_name <- paste(dir_list$plots, "Mean_plot_DPSC_iN_MS_TMT_Hum_Only_Limma", sep = "/")
plot_height <- 7
plot_width <- 7

## Using strict filters below - different from what is used elsewhere. Also, used in the GO part.
dpsc_mean_plot <- ms_data_tmt_human_only_filt_log2 %>% 
  mutate(log2_mean_iN = rowMeans(across(ends_with("_iN"))), 
         log2_mean_Native = rowMeans(across(ends_with("_DPSC")))) %>%
  inner_join(ms_data_tmt_human_only_diff_analysis_results_limma %>% select(accession, logFC, adj.P.Val, status), by = "accession") %>% 
  select(accession, status, log2_mean_iN, log2_mean_Native, -logFC, -adj.P.Val)

colours <- c("Upregulated" = "firebrick3", "Downregulated" = "steelblue", "Insignificant" = "black")

labels <- sapply(names(colours), function(level) {
  num_proteins <- ms_data_tmt_human_only_diff_analysis_results_limma %>% filter(status == level) %>% nrow()
  label <- paste(level, "(", num_proteins, ")", sep = "")
})
colour_scale <- scale_colour_manual(name = NULL, labels = labels, values = colours)

dpsc_mean_plot %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=log2_mean_Native, y=log2_mean_iN, colour=status)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.2) +
  geom_point(data = dpsc_mean_plot %>% filter(status != "Insignificant"), size = 0.8) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  colour_scale +
  labs(x = "log2(mean_Native)",
       y = "log2(mean_iN)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave(filename = paste(plot_name, "png", sep = "."), device = "png", height = plot_height, width = plot_width, limitsize = FALSE, dpi = 320, bg = "white")
ggsave(filename = paste(plot_name, "svg", sep = "."), height = plot_height, width = plot_width)
```

# GO Analysis
## GSEA
```{r}
gene_list <- ms_data_tmt_human_only_diff_analysis_results_limma_filt %>% 
  select(accession, logFC)

gene_list <- setNames(gene_list$logFC, gene_list$accession)

ms_tmt_hum_only_gse <- clusterProfiler::gseGO(geneList = gene_list, ont = "BP", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db::org.Hs.eg.db, keyType = "UNIPROT", pAdjustMethod = "BH", pvalueCutoff = 0.05, seed = 1234, eps = 0)

clusterProfiler::dotplot(ms_tmt_hum_only_gse)
```

## ORA
```{r}
genes <- ms_data_tmt_human_only_diff_analysis_results_limma_filt %>% 
  filter(status == "Upregulated") %>% 
  pull("accession")

ms_tmt_hum_only_ora_up <- clusterProfiler::enrichGO(gene = genes, universe = ms_data_tmt_human_only_diff_analysis_results_limma$accession, ont = "BP", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db::org.Hs.eg.db, keyType = "UNIPROT", pAdjustMethod = "BH", readable = TRUE)

clusterProfiler::dotplot(ms_tmt_hum_only_ora_up)

genes <- ms_data_tmt_human_only_diff_analysis_results_limma_filt %>% 
  filter(status == "Downregulated") %>% 
  pull("accession")

ms_tmt_hum_only_ora_down <- clusterProfiler::enrichGO(gene = genes, universe = ms_data_tmt_human_only_diff_analysis_results_limma$accession, ont = "BP", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db::org.Hs.eg.db, keyType = "UNIPROT", pAdjustMethod = "BH", readable = TRUE)

clusterProfiler::dotplot(ms_tmt_hum_only_ora_down)
```

## KEGG
```{r}
genes <- ms_data_tmt_human_only_diff_analysis_results_limma_filt %>% 
  filter(status == "Upregulated") %>% 
  pull("gene_id_entrez")

ms_tmt_hum_only_kegg_up <- clusterProfiler::enrichKEGG(gene = genes, organism = "hsa", universe = ms_data_tmt_human_only_diff_analysis_results_limma$gene_id_entrez, keyType = "kegg", pAdjustMethod = "BH")

clusterProfiler::dotplot(ms_tmt_hum_only_kegg_up)

genes <- ms_data_tmt_human_only_diff_analysis_results_limma_filt %>% 
  filter(status == "Downregulated") %>% 
  pull("gene_id_entrez")

ms_tmt_hum_only_kegg_down <- clusterProfiler::enrichKEGG(gene = genes, organism = "hsa", universe = ms_data_tmt_human_only_diff_analysis_results_limma$gene_id_entrez, keyType = "kegg", pAdjustMethod = "BH")

clusterProfiler::dotplot(ms_tmt_hum_only_kegg_down)
```

## Semantic Similarity Analysis
### Computing semantic similarity matrices
```{r}
# MS up GO terms filtered
ms_ora_up_filt <- ms_tmt_hum_only_ora_up@result %>% filter(p.adjust < 0.05)
ms_up_semsim_mat <- calculateSimMatrix(x = ms_ora_up_filt$ID, orgdb = "org.Hs.eg.db", ont = "BP", method = "Rel")

# MS up GO terms filtered
ms_ora_down_filt <- ms_tmt_hum_only_ora_down@result %>% filter(p.adjust < 0.05)
ms_down_semsim_mat <- calculateSimMatrix(x = ms_ora_down_filt$ID, orgdb = "org.Hs.eg.db", ont = "BP", method = "Rel")
```

### Grouping similar terms
```{r}
ms_up_semsim_grouped <- reduceSimMatrix(ms_up_semsim_mat, scores = setNames(-log10(ms_ora_up_filt$p.adjust), ms_ora_up_filt$ID), threshold = 0.7, orgdb = "org.Hs.eg.db")
ms_down_semsim_grouped <- reduceSimMatrix(ms_down_semsim_mat, scores = setNames(-log10(ms_ora_down_filt$p.adjust), ms_ora_down_filt$ID), threshold = 0.7, orgdb = "org.Hs.eg.db")
```

```{r}
treemapPlot(ms_up_semsim_grouped)
scatterPlot(ms_up_semsim_mat, ms_up_semsim_grouped)

treemapPlot(ms_down_semsim_grouped)
scatterPlot(ms_down_semsim_mat, ms_down_semsim_grouped)
```

# Marker Expression
## DPSC Markers
```{r}
annotation_col <- metadata %>% 
  column_to_rownames("sample_id") %>% 
  select(donor, cell_type)

scale_colours <- rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdBu"))
scale_colours <- colorRampPalette(scale_colours)(100)

exp_mat <- ms_data_tmt_human_only_filt_log2 %>% 
  filter(gene_name %in% dpsc_msc_markers) %>% 
  mutate(gene_name_unique = make.unique(gene_name, sep = "_")) %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var = "gene_name_unique") %>% 
  select(rownames(annotation_col))

pheatmap::pheatmap(mat = exp_mat, annotation_col = annotation_col, scale = "row", cluster_cols = FALSE, color = scale_colours,  filename = paste(dir_list$plots, "Heatmap_MS_DPSC_Markers.png", sep = "/"), gaps_col = 4, cellwidth = 10, cellheight = 10, height = 4, width = 5)
```
